audit.why: whys[3] and whys[5] both describe Quinn converting a lead — those are Quinn rows, not skill rows. The final row is the inverse error: the page gave two-plus items to Quinn while whys[6] said Riven reclaims the duel there. The packet's Skill is the correct middle reading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. The page says the blind 'zeroes her damage', and Blade of the Exile is described only as 'her R burst' — Wind Slash and the bonus attack range are never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: Blinding Assault blinds basic attacks. Riven's passive Runic Blade rides on those autos, so blinding does strip a real chunk — but Broken Wings and Ki Burst are spell damage and land in full. Telling a Quinn player the blind zeroes her damage will get them killed holding the wrong button. And Blade of the Exile (120/90/60s) grants attack damage AND attack range plus one Wind Slash, which is exactly the stat that shrinks the kite space this whole page is built on.
audit.corrected: Blind restated as stripping Runic Blade auto damage only. Blade of the Exile written in with its range gain, Wind Slash, and its 60s late cooldown. Ki Burst given 11/10/9/8/7s and named as the thing that cancels your Behind Enemy Lines channel. Broken Wings given its 13s and its third-cast knockback.

(2) Blade of the Exile grants bonus ATTACK RANGE and a Wind Slash, and neither layer mentioned it once, even though the entire game plan is built on out-spacing her.
